patterns.name: Microservices
patterns.description: Decomposed application with independently deployable services organized around business capabilities

patterns.name: Monolith
patterns.description: Single deployed application unit with tightly coupled components

patterns.name: Serverless
patterns.description: Function-as-a-service with managed auto-scaling and no server management

patterns.name: Event-Driven
patterns.description: Asynchronous communication via events and messages with loose coupling

patterns.name: Layered
patterns.description: N-tier architecture with separation of concerns into distinct layers

scalability.description: Implement horizontal auto-scaling with load balancers and container orchestration (K8s HPA/VPA)
Decompose bottleneck services and implement caching layers (Redis/Memcached) with cache invalidation strategies
Add read replicas and implement database sharding strategy for write-heavy workloads
Implement capacity planning dashboards with scaling policy metrics and utilization alerts
Implement CDN and edge caching for static assets and API responses

security.description: Enforce zero-trust network with mTLS between all services and default-deny security groups
Implement API gateway with authentication (OAuth2/OIDC) and rate limiting per client
Classify all data stores for PII and implement encryption at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3)
Establish security audit pipeline with automated vulnerability scanning (SAST/DAST) in CI/CD
Implement secrets management (Vault/AWS Secrets Manager) with automatic rotation
Establish incident response plan with security event correlation and escalation procedures

observability.description: Deploy OpenTelemetry across all services with centralized log aggregation (ELK/Loki)
Implement distributed tracing with correlation IDs across service boundaries (Jaeger/Tempo)
Define SLI/SLO targets and create alerting rules with severity-based routing (PagerDuty/Opsgenie)
Implement error budget tracking and burn rate alerting for SLO management
Add health check endpoints and readiness/liveness probes to all services

reliability.description: Deploy across multiple availability zones with automated failover and health checks
Implement circuit breakers, retry with exponential backoff and jitter, and bulkhead isolation patterns
Establish disaster recovery plan with defined RPO/RTO targets and quarterly DR drills
Implement saga pattern for distributed transaction management across services
Configure automated backup with point-in-time recovery and cross-region replication

cost.description: Implement resource right-sizing using utilization data and identify underutilized instances
Evaluate serverless for spiky workloads and reserved instances/committed use for baseline
Establish FinOps practices with cost allocation tags, budget alerts, and monthly reviews
Implement auto-shutdown for dev/test environments and spot instances for fault-tolerant workloads
Negotiate enterprise discount agreements and leverage committed use contracts

data.description: Implement event streaming pipeline (Kafka/Kinesis) for real-time data processing and ingestion
Deploy data warehouse (Snowflake/BigQuery/Redshift) with ELT pipelines and transformation layers
Build analytics dashboards with self-service BI access (Tableau/Looker/Metabase)
Implement data lake (S3/ADLS) with catalog and governance layer for raw data storage
Design CQRS pattern separating read and write models for query-heavy workloads
